fixture: User confirmed case clamped, output free, linkage disconnected; unloaded servo.
scope: Electrical ADC proxy response; no independent shaft-angle or pulse-edge measurement.
pair_validity: Require status bits 0-3, PB0/PC0 within ADC range, exact signed PB0-PC0 identity, no PB0 rail or PC0 upper rail. PC0=0 is accepted and reported separately.
age: debug[4] is floor(observation age_us/100), not conversion age. Use exact freshness status bit 3, rather than reconstructing its 1ms threshold from quantized age.
transition_detection: Final write-request debug[1] changes between 1100,1420,1700, >=100us. Require exactly three cycles of 1420->1100->1420->1700->1420 unless explicit expected-cycle argument changes.
time_zero: First logged final PWM request change; neither measured external pulse edge nor shaft movement.
baseline: Median and 1.4826*MAD of valid paired rows from -200ms to before request.
endpoint: Final 300ms median within observed hold, same as historical v4 pipeline.
early_window: Predeclared [0,20)ms for baseline-subtracted PB0, PC0 and corrected positive/negative peaks, RMS, correlation, and PC0 floor fraction. This window can contain actual movement; its reduction is not a mechanical identification.
positive_peak_reduction: 100*(1 - max(0,peak(corrected-baseline))/max(0,peak(PB0-baseline))) within early window, only if raw positive peak exceeds max(3*baseline_sigma,3counts). Unit-gain subtraction only; no fitted coefficient.
signed_identity: PB0-PC0 checked on every available paired row, including cached rows; -1 corrected count is valid and -32768 is unavailable.
response_metrics: Reuse historical v4 trial_metrics read-only for PB0, PC0 and corrected separately. Five-row sustained raw first-any/toward events, continuity-qualified established onset; 7-point median outlier replacement then 11-point local-linear levels/slopes, 21-point sensitivity, sustained crossings/overshoot and 100ms confirmation settling. PC0 may fail displacement/noise criteria; this is expected.
response_window_gate: Metrics require all rows valid/fresh, no frame gap >1.5 nominal median interval, >=100 pre-step rows and >=400ms observed hold. No interpolation of missing/stale rows. Invalid windows retain raw quality/transient summaries only.
sample_count_uncertainty: Three trials per transition are descriptive; report median/range and per-trial values, no confidence interval or universal servo specification.
sequential_sampling: Pair comes from same completed scan, not simultaneous; nominal adjacent conversion skew ~47us, potentially extended by injected internal ADC work.
limitations: PC0 cannot represent a servo-ground excursion below FC ground; zero-floor clipping can hide negative offsets.
Subtraction does not cancel potentiometer excitation/reference changes, unequal conditioning, or offset absent at the ground sense point.
Unloaded disconnected linkage does not identify flight load, motor gyroscopic torque or load-dependent latency.
Electrical first excursion is not proof of shaft motion; no angular derivative units are claimed.
Cached equal samples are not independent new conversions; age/freshness characterize acquisition progress only.
